allocationNote: Source end protection and narration-led transitions; first complete corner / next-corner follow-through kept 41 additional frames. No voice stretch, repeated frames or idle padding.
sourceReviewNotes: Opening changed to clean corner passage15s; earlier hit-at12s rejected against success wording.
Corner-result claim uses actual200s curve instead of old180s ramp/glider.
A Short Hike climb uses3.4-5.2s wall ascent and glide starts7.2s at actual launch; no walking footage labelled as flying.
Unpacking room-camera cuts kept separate; first explicit action and later repair/completion all occur on screen.
No claims about source-player skill/emotions or unknown assist state.
